defects.title: When glm-5.3-flash spends the whole max_tokens=32000 budget on reasoning and the upstream stream ends with finish_reason=length and empty content, opencode reports stopReason=end_turn with empty output and no tool calls instead of surfacing the truncation or retrying, so steps 5 and 9 'succeed' while doing nothing.
defects.expected_behavior: Surface the length truncation (ACP stopReason max_tokens or an error) or continue/retry, instead of ending the turn silently with no output.
defects.observed_behavior: Reproduced in 5 of 7 valid rounds on source 148b3053ce15 (130110Z). In each reproduced round the step-5 model response (and in four of them also step-9) ends with finish_reason=length after 32000 completion tokens, almost all reasoning, with empty content; opencode ends the turn with end_turn, empty output and no tool calls, so the step reports success while doing nothing. In one non-reproduced round the length-truncated response carried a partial tool call and opencode continued; in the other no response hit the length limit. Reproduction: 5 of 7 valid rounds on this source (148b3053ce15).
